messages:
marta_support: FYI — AcmeRetail just opened a high-priority escalation. After last night's rerank model rollout some identical queries are producing different top results. They also reported 413s for large candidate payloads and sporadic 401s. I'm pasting a repro payload + their before/after scores below.

alyssa_cs: thanks — can you paste the exact request & the failing response bodies? any request ids we can grep?

marta_support: sure — sample request (trimmed):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"query":"best winter boots for wide feet","candidates":["Brand A - insulated boot","Brand B - comfort fit","Brand C - narrow fit","Brand D - trail boot"],"top_k":4}'
```
Responses we've seen: 1) HTTP 413 when candidate list payload > ~64KB (customer says payload ~85KB), 2) intermittent HTTP 401 with body "token expired" during a burst window, 3) for same payloads the score ranking changed drastically (I pasted customer-provided before/after below). Request id headers: `x-req-id: ar-53321` and `x-client-id: acmeretail-42`.

devon_ml: noted. I saw the model swap in the deploy logs: rerank model rolled to rerank-v2-quant at 1955549800 UTC (PR #4823). The new preprocessing pipeline includes whitespace normalization + punctuation trimming which can alter tokenization for short candidate strings. That alone can flip scores for close ties. Also quantization tweaks changed logits scaling slightly.

ryan_engineer: can you paste the raw scores? easiest repro is to run the same payload against the previous model binary and the new one with identical seed/environment. Example quick check: 
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @payload.json https://staging.redwood/internal/rerank_debug | jq '.scores'
```
Make sure to set header `x-override-model: rerank-legacy-2026-01` to force old model.

marta_support: customer provided before/after (same input):
- Before (legacy): [ {"id":"A","score":0.935},{"id":"B","score":0.872},{"id":"C","score":0.411} ]
- After (v2-quant): [ {"id":"A","score":0.762},{"id":"B","score":0.893},{"id":"C","score":0.435} ]
They say this caused UI to surface Brand B above Brand A which impacted conversions. They also included a trace link: https://redwood.internal/traces/ar-53321 (internal).

sam_ops: looking at infra metrics — at rollout time we saw a short autoscaler oscillation for the tenant's dedicated pool (cpu/gpu thrash) which likely caused retries from their side. Those retries plus a token-service hiccup explain the 401 bursts. The 413s are coming from our request-body limit in the edge proxy (we default to 64KB for rerank to mitigate huge candidate lists). Customer was sending large candidate sets.

deploy_bot: [deploy] rerank-v2-quant rolled to prod at 1955549800 by @devon_ml — rollout registry: https://ci.redwood/deploys/4823 :white_check_mark:

devon_ml: mitigation proposal: 1) for affected tenant, rollback to `rerank-legacy-2026-01` (canary) for 1h while we run a targeted evaluation on their canonical prompt set; 2) patch preprocessing: revert whitespace normalization for short candidate tokens and add a deterministic normalizer flag; 3) raise the edge proxy limit for authenticated enterprise tenants to 128KB temporarily or return more explicit 413 with guidance.

alyssa_cs: AcmeRetail asked for rollback ASAP and will accept a canary rollback for their account only. tagging account team and legal for the change. @ryan_engineer can you schedule the tenancy rollback and add the temporary request-size exception? :pray:

ryan_engineer: I'll schedule a tenant-scoped rollback in the next 30m window and add an exception rule for acmeretail-42 to allow 128KB until we have a better client-side compaction story. I'll also add backoff to the token refresh path to avoid cascading 401s. Putting a runbook link here: https://playbooks.redwood/runbooks/tenant_rerank_rollback

marta_support: I'll send the customer a timeline + repro steps (how to force the legacy model) and ask them to pause replays. Also asking them to reduce candidate batch sizes as immediate workaround.

sam_ops: note — billing spike for the tenant looks correlated with automated retry loops during the burst. Finance flagged a temporary credit request; let's hold off until rollback effect confirmed.

devon_ml: after rollback we'll run an A/B over their eval set and produce a delta report (score diffs + ROC/precision tests) and include suggested preprocessing config for their workspace.

ryan_engineer: rolling now. will post final completion time and affected request ids. :thumbsup:

marta_support: thanks everyone — I'll update AcmeRetail after rollback completes and attach eval diffs.
